chore(deps): bump the weekly-cargo-patches group with 2 updates

Bumps the weekly-cargo-patches group with 2 updates: [toml](https://github.com/toml-rs/toml) and [clap_complete](https://github.com/clap-rs/clap).


Updates `toml` from 1.1.3+spec-1.1.0 to 1.1.4+spec-1.1.0
- [Commits](https://github.com/toml-rs/toml/compare/toml-v1.1.3...toml-v1.1.4)

Updates `clap_complete` from 4.6.7 to 4.6.8
